name: comp-220
title: Status Select
description: A labelled dropdown whose trigger shows the current status as a coloured dot and a word. Opening it lists Completed, In Progress, Pending, Cancelled and Failed, each with its own dot and the chosen row ticked.
use: Changing a record's state in a list or detail panel, where colour helps status read at a glance.
avoid: The five states are fixed in the file, and the dots lean on colour alone, so a new workflow needs edits.
a11y: The label is tied to the trigger and the dots are hidden decoration, so options read by name; the open and close animation has no reduced-motion guard. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small Status select caption sits above a rounded trigger holding a green dot, the word Completed and a chevron. Opened, a dark panel drops below with five rows, each a small coloured dot and a status word, the current one ending in a tick.
behaves: Clicking the trigger drops the list; hovering a row lifts it to a lighter grey, and clicking one sets the trigger's dot and word and closes the panel. The clip ends on Pending.
customise: The five statuses, their dot colours and the default value are written in the file; edit them there. Trigger padding, dot size and menu spacing are classes in the same file.
weight: light: One listbox popup with five short rows and a small open and close animation.
